verses.tl: Yusabbihu Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardil-malikil-quddoosil-azeezil-hakeem
Huwal-ladhee ba'atha fil-ummiyyeena rasoolan minhum yatloo alayhim aayaatihi wa yuzakkeehim wa yu'allimuhumul-kitaaba wal-hikmata wa in kaanoo min qablu lafee dalaalin mubeen
Wa aakhareena minhum lammaa yalhaqoo bihim wa huwal-azeezul-hakeem
Dhaalika fadlu Allaahi yu'teehi man yashaa'u Wallaahu dhul-fadlil-azeem
Mathalul-ladheena hummilut-tawraata thumma lam yahmiloohaa kamathalil-himaari yahmilu asfaaran bi'sa mathalul-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaati Allaahi Wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Qul yaa ayyuhal-ladheena haadoo in za'amtum annakum awliyaa u Lillaahi min doonin-naasi fatamannaw al-mawta in kuntum saadiqeen
Wa laa yatamannawnahu abadan bimaa qaddamat aydeehim Wallaahu aleemun biz-zaalimeen
Qul innal-mawtal-ladhee tafirroona minhu fa-innahu mulaaqeekum thumma turaddoona ilaa aalimil-ghaybi wash-shahaadati fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa noodee lis-salaati min yawmil-jumu'ati faas'aw ilaa dhikri Allaahi wa dharul-bay'a dhaalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
Fa-idhaa qudiyatis-salaatu fantashiroo fil-ardi wabtaghoo min fadlillaahi wadhkuroo Allaaha katheeran la-allakum tuflihoon
Wa idhaa ra'aw tijaaratan aw lahwan infaddoo ilayhaa wa tarakooka qaa'iman qul maa indallaahi khayrun mina Allaahwi wa minat-tijaarati Wallaahu khayrur-raaziqeen
